method.independence: Authored after the contract/source freeze and before any new runtime, native implementation, or evaluator. No new implementation was read and no acquisition/inference runtime was executed.
method.cell_derivation: Hand-derived literal complete-word arrays using the declared carrier order and cell=4*index+state; literal word arrays reused in authored clause sequences. No classifier, source-normalizer, transition simulator, or runtime oracle generated expected cells.
method.conditional_derivation: Existing PR34 finite generative token grammar, signed forward rules, and explicit shape law were read as specifications. Query spelling remains exact; raw mark-order and U+0671 acquisition variants do not enter PR34 automatically.
method.coverage: Every finite stem has all three explicit ordinary ending vowels under wasl and waqf, and each stem has a connected-onset contrast under both endings. Initial scalar/mark conventions and both haqq shadda/vowel orders occur. This is preimplementation independence over known finite vocabulary, not a fresh held-out lexicon.
method.goal_policy: Positive acquisition goals include finite connected-onset representations still required but unimplemented. Positive person/nominal requirements remain UNMEASURED and coverage misses. Positive conditional goals include known supported readings blocked by connected acquisition or exact PR34 spelling coverage; they remain misses unless the full chain supports the exact query.
method.negative_policy: Ambiguous/out-of-registry malformed article inputs are counterexample controls. Missing/negated premises, changed subjects, quotation, unresolved references, conflict, and altered active/passive marks must not yield unwarranted supported chains.
method.boundary_policy: Type, resource, source-id/revision/scope/time binding, missing native checker, source inventory, and receipt mutation tests are separate boundary tests and do not inflate these linguistic denominators.
method.measurement_limits: Person/category and nominal syntax have no implemented evaluator; neither representations nor cell equality establish those goals. Source hashes identify retained evidence, not semantic truth. First execution must be retained, including failures; repairs are exposed replay, never relabeling.
